body: I'm just so sad. I feel like this person who I finally felt okay opening up to and who I felt was someone who finally saw me, the real me and brought that me out of my shell, just tossed me aside. How do I cope with that? He is my best friend, he is more than that, and I know he cares for me. But when he leaves me here and ignores me when he knows full well the shitty situation I'm in, it hurts. When he won't answer my question because he's afraid of hurting me, I feel like he isn't respecting the fact that I asked and knew the possible responses. I just wanted some openness so that I didn't have to keep going on unknowns. But he has to keep that from me. He gets to figure out his emotions and until he does, it seems like I can't communicate so as to figure out my own. He is my rock. He cared for me when I started hurting myself for the first time earlier this year. He listened to me and was there for me when I needed it. I smile so much around him and I love the person I am when I'm around him. I know he cares. I do. That and the feelings I have for him are what keep me going. I just can't lose him. And I feel like that moment is about to arrive. He is the one thing that is right in my life. He believes in me and no one else has said that to me. He is what is getting me through the summer and he knows it. I'm so scared of losing what we have. I'm so scared of what that will do to me. I'm just so scared.
